messages.author: 68b43d6f8c308775
messages.subject: Replacing best parameters in SWAT+
parts:
Hello,

Could you let me know if anyone has an idea on how to replace default SWAT+ parameters with the best parameter values which were obtained using RSWAT in a SWAT+ project? 

I plan to validate other hydrologic variables using my calibrated model parameters.

Regards,

Kingsley

messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: Replacing best parameters in SWAT+
parts:
Please see section 3.8. Read_User_Parameter_File  in this documentation

https://github.com/tamnva/R-SWAT/wiki/R-SWAT-User-Manual#38-read_user_parameter_file

Here you just run again with the best parameter set and a TxtInOut folder in the working folder will be created with the best parameter values
